title: China Q2 GDP growth slows to 4.3%, H1 at 4.7% — weakest quarterly pace in over 3 years
summary: National Bureau of Statistics released July 15: Q2 GDP +4.3% YoY (vs 4.5% consensus), Q1 was +5.0%. H1 total 69.57 trillion yuan, +4.7% YoY. Real estate investment fell 18%; new growth drivers (AI, advanced manufacturing) contributed >40% of growth. Officials attribute slowdown to external shocks and pledge additional H2 policy support.
why: Q2增速低于目标区间下限，政策加码预期升温；对科技/消费持仓影响偏正（刺激预期），但宏观疲软压制周期板块。期权层面，沪深300波动率或因政策博弈短期走宽。

title: US CPI Falls for First Time Since 2020 in June; Core Gauge Unchanged — Fed July Hike Door Slams Shut
summary: Bloomberg, July 14: June headline CPI fell 0.4% MoM (first monthly drop since 2020), pulling annual rate to 3.5%. Core CPI flat at 0% MoM, YoY 2.6% — coolest print since 2021. S&P 500 +0.38% to 7,543; Nasdaq +0.9% to 26,107; semiconductor ETF SMH +2.5%. Gasoline and shelter cost declines drove the beat.
why: CPI超预期降温，7月加息概率从42%骤降至17%，风险资产全线反弹；对持有美股科技/芯片仓位明显利好。Sell put策略受益于方向性支撑，但隐含波动率可能同步收缩。

title: 港股收评：恒指涨1.4%，科指涨1.3%；美团涨超5%，腾讯涨超3%，MINIMAX涨超13%；生物医药强势
summary: 7月15日港股收盘：恒生指数涨1.4%报24681点，恒生科技指数涨1.3%，国企指数涨1%。科网股全线上行，美团+5%、联想+3%、腾讯+3%；AI应用股MINIMAX单日涨超13%；药明合联+7%，中金公司+5%。国家卫健委发布2026版国家基本药物目录（9月1日起施行）。
why: 美团、腾讯均为持仓核心标的，当日大幅走高直接利好组合净值；若短期维持强势需警惕covered call行权压力，2026版药物目录对生物医药细分赛道构成催化。

title: Asian Stocks Bounce on Wall Street Inflation Relief but China Stumbles — KOSPI Surges 7.1%, SK Hynix +9.4%
summary: July 15: South Korea's KOSPI led Asian gains at +7.1% (7,343), with SK Hynix +9.4% and Samsung +6.1% on memory sector rebound. Japan Nikkei +0.9% to 68,354. China Shanghai Composite edged down 0.4% as Q2 GDP disappointed at 4.3%. Hong Kong Hang Seng +1.4%, led by tech. Regional rally driven by softer US June CPI released overnight.
why: 亚太多市场联动上涨，SK海力士美股SKHY+日韩联动验证HBM主题持续；中国A股疲软可能令相关对冲仓位Beta分化，需关注下半年政策刺激节奏以决定是否加仓A股期权。

title: 中东局势重燃油价上行担忧：美伊紧张升级，特朗普称担任霍尔木兹「守护者」；WTI或破$90
summary: 7月13日特朗普宣称美国将成霍尔木兹海峡「守护者」并拟对过境船只收取20%通行费，美伊军事对抗继续。WTI原油近期在$73附近徘徊，金联创分析师警示：若局势持续，油价潜在上目标$90以上。OPEC将2026年需求增长预测下调至78万桶/日，IEA预计因战争影响全球消费减少100万桶/日。
why: 油价上行对通胀预期构成边际压力，或重燃美联储加息预期，利空高估值成长持仓；老铺黄金等避险资产受益，需动态评估地缘风险对期权隐含波动率的推高效应。

title: Cooler US CPI Slams Door on July Fed Hike: Rate Hike Odds Fall to 17% from 42%; Next FOMC July 28-29
summary: Benzinga, July 14: CME FedWatch July hike odds fell to 17% (vs 42% pre-CPI). Fed funds rate holds at 3.50-3.75%. Minutes from June meeting signaled no cuts until early 2027. Market now prices Fed on hold through year-end unless inflation re-accelerates (Middle East oil risks key wildcard). Next FOMC meeting July 28-29 under Chair Kevin Warsh.
why: 加息概率骤降减少估值折现压力，利好科技/消费组合；中东油价风险是逆转因子，若7月FOMC发出鹰派信号可能重创高倍数仓位。建议7月下旬前后关注短期波动率交易机会。

title: ByteDance and Alibaba disable humanlike AI custom agents today as China's new AI companion rules take effect
summary: SCMP: ByteDance's Doubao and Alibaba's Qwen shut down user-created AI agent features on July 15, coinciding with enforcement of China's Interim Measures for Anthropomorphic AI Interaction Services. Rules mandate anti-addiction systems, under-14 identity checks and always-available exit options. User agent data permanently deleted. Platforms had months to prepare; both companies confirmed permanent shutdown with no migration path.
why: 阿里Qwen智能体功能强制下线，合规成本上升但BABA/9988股价影响有限；监管边界扩大意味着整个AI应用赛道面临合规不确定性，可关注监管催化期权隐波上行机会。

title: SK Hynix soars 13% in Nasdaq debut (SKHY), closes at $168 — $26.5B IPO second-largest US listing ever
summary: Fast Company: SK Hynix regular-way trading began July 13 under SKHY. Stock closed at $168.01 (+12.8% vs $149 IPO price) in first session, on $26.5B raised — second-largest US IPO ever. SK Hynix holds ~60% HBM market share. In Seoul on July 15, KOSPI surged 7.1% with SK Hynix jumping 9.4%. Company slowing HBM4 ramp to prioritize DDR5 margin optimization.
why: SK海力士美股SKHY上市首日大涨，HBM赛道估值中枢上移；南向两倍做多产品受益，隐含波动率可能随新股流动性建立而逐步正常化。HBM4E样品已送主要客户，下一轮业绩催化可期。

title: Nvidia NVDA tests $212 as AI demand surges; US confirms limited H200 GPU exports to China under BIS license
summary: FX Leaders, July 15: NVDA approaches $212 technical resistance with market cap >$5.1T. US officials confirmed first H200 GPU shipments to China under BIS license (capped at 50% of US domestic volume). Next-gen Kyber server cabinet delayed to 2028 due to circuit board manufacturing failures. DOJ/FTC expanding antitrust probe of CUDA hardware lock-in.
why: 英伟达股价持续创历史新高，AI芯片需求旺盛；中国H200出口受限但已开闸，为中国AI产业链提供边际利好；Kyber延期2028影响数据中心升级节奏。$200附近sell put收益依然可观。

title: A股7月15日开盘：半导体、存储芯片、先进封装领涨；超2900股飘绿；智谱涨超6%
summary: 7月15日A股开盘分化：沪指低开0.09%，深证成指+0.31%，创业板+0.74%，科创综指+0.81%。半导体、存储芯片、先进封装、电子布、培育钻石涨幅居前；油气开采、航天军工、煤炭领跌。AI应用方向智谱相关涨超6%；超2900只个股飘绿，市场分化明显，沪指今日已涨至约3967点区域。
why: A股科技/半导体板块与港美联动，但大盘整体分化说明资金选择性强；消费赛道表现平淡，建议重点关注港股科技标的跨市场溢价及A股存储芯片相关个股期权机会。

title: Intel INTC jumps 4.5% on July 15 as AI chip demand lifts tech sector; 18A yields tracking ahead of schedule
summary: FX Leaders, July 15: INTC rises 4.5% in session, outperforming broader tech. Company reports 18A process yields running ahead of internal projections; 14A also tracking ahead of 18A at comparable stage. External foundry customers (Microsoft, AWS) design commitments expected late 2026/early 2027. Q1 2026 IFS operating loss ~$2.4B; headcount cut to 75,000. HSBC raised target to $200.
why: 英特尔代工业务转好信号出现，若18A良率持续改善可能逐步争回AI芯片市场份额；但巨额亏损意味着短期基本面压力较大，sell put需注意财报日（7月下旬）波动风险。
